purpose: Teach: こむ/採っ/ひざ/向く/在る/挙句/物語っ/できあがっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが家に駆けこむと皆が安心した
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad would rush home and everyone felt safe.
lines.style: Soft, distant recollection. Gaze drifting inward. Slow, deliberate pace with weight on each memory. Voice trails like holding onto something fading.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、山菜を採ってこられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, Grandpa — he'd bring home wild mountain vegetables, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, affirming tone. Small smile in the voice. Gently correcting the record with her own memory. Familiar, intimate rhythm of long partnership.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが孫をひざに乗せて遊ばれた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad would sit the grandchildren on his knee and play with them.
lines.style: Same wistful opening. Quieter this time — the memory catching slightly. Slight pause before continuing, as if seeing it again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お墓に向く時間を大切にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, he was careful about taking time at the grave, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle correction again, but with a note of reverence. Slower on the middle phrase. Affirming his dignity in the memory, not just correcting him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがどこに在る時も家族を気にされた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad cared for the family no matter where he was.
lines.style: Quieter now, more intimate. Almost speaking to himself. The wistfulness deepens — this is the core of what he's remembering. Voice steadies with the importance of it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、議論の挙句、決断を即座にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, after all those discussions, he'd make his decision right away, wouldn't he, dear?
lines.style: A thread of gentle humor. Accepting his decisiveness even when it maybe frustrated her. Warm, understanding. The knowing laugh of fifty years together.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが戦時中の体験を物語って下さった
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad would tell us stories about his time in the war.
lines.style: Voice slows, deepens. This memory carries weight. Pause before 'war' — respect for what he endured. Trailing end, as if the stories still echo.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様の作品ができあがった時、誉められたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, when the grandchildren finished their artwork, he'd always praise them, wouldn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warmest yet. A small catch of happiness in her voice. Soft fade on the closing words — the tenderness of him seeing them succeed. Present tense in her affection.
